issues.body:
## Goal
Every telemetry signal Socrates collects feeds back into a decision that improves it, with sane defaults: estimation (ETAs, sizes, cost), staffing (tier and model choice), orchestration (routing, pacing, leases) and the skills that make those calls. Tom asked for confirmation several times (12 Oct); nobody has audited the loop end to end.

Category: audit + fixes

## Known pieces (each built separately, never audited as one loop)
- firn#11, firn#19, firn#5: run, stage, context and Codex telemetry collected (threads, worker-ledger).
- north#28: brief ETAs from the worker ledger.
- firn#2: tier choice from category history.
- north#13: usage-aware staffing.
- Today's harness work: pace loop, cost ledger, value per ticket.
- north#17 (open): resource estimator.

## Done when
- [ ] An inventory lists each signal collected, the decision or skill that reads it, and whether that read happens on main today. Signals that nothing reads are either wired in or dropped, with the reason.
- [ ] Estimation is calibrated: on the last 7 days of finished boxes, predicted vs actual for ETA and $ is reported (median ratio and the spread), and the estimator uses those numbers as its default.
- [ ] Staffing is calibrated: success rate and $ per box by tier and category feed the tier pick. A replayed week of decisions shows the pick changes where history says it should.
- [ ] Defaults are sane: every threshold or prior in these loops has a stated source (measured, or a named Tom decision) and a fallback for when data is thin.
- [ ] A recurring recalibration runs inside the hourly loop or the weekly share review, not by hand, and is visible in `agents report`.
